description: Modern typed .NET client for the DK Plus v1 and v2 APIs.
releaseNotes: v0.3.0 (breaking): every IDkPlusClient read member returns a sealed DkPlus subtype of the portable model (DkPlusCustomer, DkPlusVendor, DkPlusProduct, DkPlusProject, DkPlusEmployee, DkPlusSalesInvoice, DkPlusSalesOrder, DkPlusSalesQuote, DkPlusRecurringSale, DkPlusSalesPerson), while IExternalErpClient keeps returning the portable types. ERPC-21: VatNumber, IndustryClassificationCode, Gender, VatExempt and ReceivablesAccount are DkPlusCustomer members and are projectable with Include. Writes use one pattern per entity: a CreateRequest for the full document and a sparse UpdateRequest whose identity is the path argument; null means unchanged and an empty string is sent as written. The overloads that accepted read models, CustomerCreateRequest wrapper, Vendor.NoVat alias and SalesPersonDetails are removed. Renames include InvoiceDraft to SalesInvoiceCreateRequest, InvoiceLine to SalesInvoiceLineRequest, VendorInvoiceDraft to VendorInvoiceCreateRequest, ProjectRequest to WorkRequest (Project.WorkRequest), VendorBankAccount to BankAccount and CustomerOptions to flat DkPlusCustomer members. Swagger-enumerated fields are C# enums; unknown wire values read as null and are kept in AdditionalData. Request extension data never overrides a typed member. v1 invoice and v2 document parties reject members DK Plus cannot store before any request is sent. v2 sales documents map the contact Address, keep unknown nested party, contact, carrier and extra-details members in AdditionalData (and unknown Dimensions and Payment members in the parent's AdditionalData), type Receiver as DkPlusSalesDocumentParty, and accept DiscountAmount and a line Sequence; UpdateLineAsync copies the path sequence into the body (matching by Sequence on a head PUT is unverified live). A contact City or fourth address line, and party or contact data a v1 invoice cannot store, are rejected before sending. Raw include lists (vendor page, project and work-request lists, ledger accounts) always select the identity and exclude lists may not drop it; a read without its identity raises DkPlusContractException. Work-request updates copy the path id into the body, and non-string vendor-invoice approval status tokens read as null with the raw value retained. Vendor invoice attachments use FileAttachment and a missing name or content raises DkPlusContractException. Privacy: the employee payroll fields SpouseName, BankAccount, SalaryCode, PaymentFrequency and PaymentMode are stripped from AdditionalData on every employee read and are never written; an employee projection may Exclude them but not Include them. Employee, v1 sales invoice (Number) and v2 sales document (Id/UId) projections always include the identity and refuse to exclude it. DkPlusGender is renamed Gender and TokenUpdate is renamed TokenUpdateRequest. v2 order and quote Status (SalesDocumentStatus), order DeliveryStatus (SalesOrderDeliveryStatus, also on DkPlusSalesOrder) and project Status (ProjectStatus) are enums validated before sending. Salesperson, v2 document and project-phase create requests enforce their [Required] members before any I/O, and work-entry writes no longer send JSON null extension values. Retains the portable-read and DK-specific separation, DkPlus projections, correlation IDs and resilience behavior of earlier releases.
title: DevOp dkPlus Client
